text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening claim: \"I don't think that driverless cars are a good investment\"","quality":"position clarity","description":"The essay states its stance directly and keeps that stance easy to identify from the start."},{"evidence":"paragraphs on awareness, laziness, control, and fault","quality":"reason development","description":"The essay builds its argument through several distinct supporting points instead of relying on a single complaint."},{"evidence":"\"who is to blame for accidents\" and \"the fault of the 'driver' or the company\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible opposing concern and turns it back into support for its own position."},{"evidence":"\"Some people would have to agree...\" followed by response","quality":"argument balance","description":"The essay briefly presents the other side before rebutting it, which makes the argument feel more reasoned."},{"evidence":"closing lines about history changing and driving being freedom","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends by restating its main view in a way that provides a more complete sense of closure."}]}
